name: even-qwen
description: Qwen Omni voice assistant for Even G2 glasses.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @even-qwen/protocol && npm run build -w @even-qwen/g2-client && npm run build -w @even-qwen/desktop-agent
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @even-qwen/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @even-qwen/protocol && npm run build -w @even-qwen/desktop-agent && node --test scripts/test-protocol-v2.mjs scripts/test-store.mjs scripts/test-tools.mjs scripts/test-qwen-session.mjs
scripts.pack:g2: npm run build -w @even-qwen/g2-client && npm run check:release-secrets && evenhub pack apps/g2-client/app.json apps/g2-client/dist --sdk-ver 0.0.14 -o even-qwen.ehpk
